moments.evidence: Una galleda cap per avall sosté una pilota d’escuma encaixada al cul sobre una vora baixa.
Inclina i aixeca la galleda per la nansa. La pilota surt de la concavitat pel costat baix.
La pilota és a l’estora. La galleda és buida i encara és a la mà.

continuity.anchor: Una galleda amb nansa recta i una pilota amb dues bandes.

attempts.prompt: Generate exactly one finished raster illustration for classroom causal reasoning. Landscape canvas, three equally wide side-by-side panels with broad pure white gutters and generous outer margins. Flat 2D educational picture book art of one friendly recognizable anthropomorphic cat, solid colors, clean outlines, correct functional anatomy and no additional human arms. Same agent and exact fixed 3/4 camera, light direction, scene layout, object sizes and geometry across the panels. Maximize legibility of the contact point and result while leaving margins around every object and body. Use minimal supports and white backdrop. Catalan brief, interpret in the pictures: LEFT state of departure: Una galleda cap per avall sosté una pilota d’escuma encaixada al cul sobre una vora baixa. CENTER explicit physical cause: Inclina i aixeca la galleda per la nansa. La pilota surt de la concavitat pel costat baix. RIGHT consequence: La pilota és a l’estora. La galleda és buida i encara és a la mà. Continuity and object accounting: Una galleda amb nansa recta i una pilota amb dues bandes.  No graphic arrows, movement lines, words, letters, numbers, signage, logo or watermark. Keep all object edges, hand contact and supports physically coherent. Three panels, readable left to right.
attempts.review: La galleda tapa la pilota al començament i la pilota apareix de sota seu. L’acció la descobreix, en lloc de fer-la perdre el suport superior de la galleda.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic cat; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Una galleda cap per avall sosté una pilota d’escuma encaixada al cul sobre una vora baixa. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Inclina i aixeca la galleda per la nansa. La pilota surt de la concavitat pel costat baix. RIGHT result: La pilota és a l’estora. La galleda és buida i encara és a la mà. Continuity and accounting: Una galleda amb nansa recta i una pilota amb dues bandes. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: IMPORTANT in panel one a yellow foam ball with two stripes is entirely visible PERCHED ABOVE the upward-facing flat closed base of an UPSIDE-DOWN bucket; the OPEN mouth of the bucket faces down and the handle is folded down against the bucket. In side view the bottom of the ball directly touches a shallow cup-shaped depression in the outer base on the TOP of the inverted bucket. DO NOT put the ball below or inside the bucket. The agent tilts the inverted bucket holding it by handle, the ball rolls off the TOP, then lies to its side on the mat.
attempts.review: La pilota és damunt la base inicial, però després apareix sota la boca de la galleda i recolzada al banc. Encara falta veure-la sortir de la concavitat superior quan s’inclina.

CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Inclina i aixeca la galleda per la nansa. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Encara falta veure-la sortir de la concavitat superior quan s’inclina. Show a SINGLE yellow ball with two blue stripes PERCHED ON TOP OF the closed upper end of a fully upside-down blue bucket in LEFT, open mouth flat against ground. CENTER: tilt upside-down bucket by only 25 degrees without flipping it, opening still diagonally DOWN AND LEFT, and the ball still high up, resting against the RIGHT LIP on the OUTSIDE of the closed bottom (now TOP) as it rolls off.
